headline: ADD Properties Secures $265 Million Financing for Grand Hyatt Giza Hotel
summary: ADD Properties secured a $265 million syndicated financing facility from regional and international institutions to develop a 400-room Grand Hyatt hotel overlooking the Pyramids of Giza.
why: Large syndicated loans for hospitality projects illustrate ongoing foreign and domestic institutional backing for Egypt's tourism infrastructure sector.

impacts.name: ADD Properties
impacts.why: The company secured a substantial $265 million credit facility for property development.
